issue: Torchvision 0.23 GTSRB downloader selects the IJCNN2011 training archive, not the final full training archive.
guard: Data preparation requires exactly 39209 official final training images and 12630 official test images; the count assertion failed before caching or training.
resolution: Use GTSRB_Final_Training_Images.zip from the same official ERDA archive; its training root is GTSRB/Final_Training/Images.
checksum_reference_note: This expected SHA256 is a third-party published checksum. The archive bytes are downloaded from the official distribution; the checksum is not claimed to be issued by the original dataset authors.
